items.title: Margot Robbie - 20 Funny Clips
items.style: Write a short, funny narrator introduction for each supplied Margot Robbie clip, in the exact supplied order. Ground every scene only in the matching clip description and transcript. Keep intro clips to one or two punchy sentences and never merge clips. Do not invent quotes or events. Generate English narration and audio.
